'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] approves of sending non-persistent [[anti-personnel mine]]s to Ukraine, with Ukraine committing to not use them in areas with civilians. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/20/ukraine-to-get-us-land-mines-for-use-against-russian-forces-reports (Al Jazeera)]
***The [[United Kingdom]] and [[France]] both prepare new military packages containing [[Storm Shadow|long-range missiles]] to send to Ukraine following President Biden's decision to allow deep strikes into Russian territory using [[United States|American]] weapons. [https://www.newsweek.com/nato-ukraine-missiles-joe-biden-1988037?utm_term=Autofeed&utm_medium=Social&utm_source=Twitter#Echobox=1732016216 (''Newsweek'')]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Ukraine]] launches [[ATACMS]] [[ballistic missile]]s at targets in [[Bryansk Oblast]], [[Russia]], according to the [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defence Ministry]]. It is the first time that Ukraine has used the [[United States|American]]-supplied missiles to strike targets inside Russia. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0mzjm7knw7o (BBC News)]
**[[Nuclear risk during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Russia and weapons of mass destruction]]
***[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] signs a [[Decree of the President of Russia|decree]] that allows Russia to use [[nuclear weapon]]s in response to [[Conventional weapon|conventional]] attacks by a non-nuclear state supported by a [[List of states with nuclear weapons|nuclear power]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-issues-warning-us-with-new-nuclear-doctrine-2024-11-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***Three [[Lebanese Armed Forces|Lebanese soldiers]] are killed and 17 other people are injured in an [[Israel]]i airstrike in [[Sarafand, Lebanon|Sarafand]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/20/israeli-attack-kills-three-more-lebanese-soldiers-as-death-toll-passes-forty (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/beirut-says-3-lebanese-soldiers-killed-in-israeli-airstrike-in-south/ (Times of Israel)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**Twenty-eight suspected gang members are killed by police and residents in [[Pétion-Ville]], [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/19/haitian-authorities-say-28-alleged-gang-members-killed-by-police-residents (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2024/11/20/haiti-police-civilians-kill-28-gang-members-say-authorities/ (''The Jamaica Observer'')]
**[[Doctors Without Borders]] announces it will suspend operations in Port-au-Prince indefinitely following [[rape threat|rape]] and [[death threat]]s from [[Haitian National Police|Haitian police]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/haiti-doctors-without-borders-halts-work-in-port-au-prince/a-70826801 (DW)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Twelve [[Pakistan Army|soldiers]] are killed and others are wounded after a [[Suicide attack|suicide]] [[car bomb]]ing targeting a security post in [[Bannu]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. Six [[Hafiz Gul Bahadur Group]] gunmen are killed in the ensuing [[shootout]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-suicide-bombing-security-forces-killed-f17f4521de40a27e3ebf76ccf15d58ec (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2024 Boeing machinists strike]]
**American [[aerospace manufacturer|aerospace company]] [[Boeing]] announces it will [[layoff]] 17,000 workers by the end of 2024, 10% of its global workforce, due to financial difficulties following the [[2024 Boeing machinists strike|machinists strike]]. [https://www.assemblymag.com/articles/98910-boeing-to-lay-off-17-000-workers-amid-financial-struggles (''Assembly Magazine'')] [https://www.wafb.com/2024/11/20/boeing-cut-nearly-20000-employees-before-christmas/ (WAFB9)] 

'''International relations'''
*[[2024 G20 Rio de Janeiro summit]]
**[[South Africa]] becomes the first country from [[Africa]] to chair the [[G20]] after receiving the leadership position during the second day of the summit in [[Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]]. [https://en.tempo.co/read/1943387/south-africa-becomes-first-african-country-to-lead-g20 (''Tempo'')]

'''Law and crime''' 
*[[2020 Hong Kong pro-democracy primaries]], [[Hong Kong 47]]
**Forty-five [[pro-democracy camp|pro-democracy]] activists in [[Hong Kong]] are sentenced to prison terms of between four and 10 years over an unofficial primary held in 2020. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/hundreds-queue-sentencing-47-hong-kong-democrats-2024-11-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022–2023 Brazilian election protests]]
**[[Federal Police of Brazil|Brazilian Federal Police]] arrest five people, including four [[G20]] security guards, for their alleged involvement in a plot to [[assassinate]] [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Lula da Silva]] and [[Vice President of Brazil|Vice President]] [[Geraldo Alckmin]] following the [[2022 Brazilian general election|general election]] in 2022. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/19/brazil-arrests-five-suspects-in-alleged-lula-assassination-plot (Al Jazeera)]
*The [[Tunisian Armed Forces#Navy|Tunisian coast guard]] announces that on the night of November 8, a patrol boat rammed and sank a boat carrying migrants on its coasts, killing 53 people. [https://www.fanpage.it/politica/la-guardia-costiera-tunisina-sperona-e-uccide-52-migranti-mio-cugino-musa-e-uno-dei-minori-annegati-quella-notte/ (Fanpage)]

**Thousands of [[British people|British]] [[farmer]]s protest at the [[Houses of Parliament]] in [[London]], [[United Kingdom]], against a new [[inheritance tax]] on [[land ownership]] that includes [[farm]]s. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/19/british-farmers-protest-against-tractor-tax-on-inheritance (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czj71zyy934o (BBC News)]
*[[2024 Venezuelan presidential election]], [[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**The United States announces it recognizes [[Venezuela]]n [[Venezuelan opposition|opposition leader]] [[Edmundo González]] as the [[President of Venezuela|President-elect]] following the presidential election in July. **Over 40,000 people gather in front of the [[New Zealand]] [[Parliament House, Wellington|Parliament House]] in [[Wellington]] to protest against the [[Treaty Principles Bill]] that would change [[Māori people]]'s rights, making it one of the largest protests in the country.
